components.name: BookController
responsibilities: Expose REST endpoints for book registration, update, retrieval and deletion
Bind and validate request DTOs using @Valid
Return ResponseEntity with appropriate HTTP status and Location header on creation
Delegate all business operations to BookService

components.name: BookService
responsibilities: Implement book catalog use cases: register, update title, retrieve by ISBN, delete by ISBN
Enforce unique ISBN invariant and book existence checks
Set createdAt and updatedAt timestamps
Map between domain Book and response DTO

components.name: BookRepository
responsibilities: Persist and query Book entities by ISBN and id
Provide existsByIsbn, findByIsbn and deleteByIsbn operations

components.name: Book
responsibilities: Domain entity mapped to the books table
Encapsulate id, isbn, title, author, createdAt and updatedAt attributes
Declare bean validation constraints for persistence fields

components.name: CreateBookRequest
responsibilities: DTO for POST /api/v1/books request body
Carry isbn, title and author fields
Apply ISBN and text validation constraints

components.name: UpdateBookRequest
responsibilities: DTO for PUT /api/v1/books/{isbn} request body
Carry title field for metadata correction
Apply non-blank and size validation constraints

components.name: BookResponse
responsibilities: DTO for book representation returned by REST endpoints
Carry id, isbn, title, author, createdAt and updatedAt fields

components.name: ErrorResponse
responsibilities: Standard error payload for REST API errors
Carry errorCode, message and field-level validation details

components.name: BookNotFoundException
responsibilities: Signal that no book exists for a requested ISBN
Support BOOK_NOT_FOUND error mapping

components.name: BookIsbnDuplicateException
responsibilities: Signal that a book with the same ISBN already exists
Support BOOK_ISBN_DUPLICATE error mapping

components.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
responsibilities: Translate validation errors into HTTP 400 responses
Translate BookIsbnDuplicateException into HTTP 409 with errorCode BOOK_ISBN_DUPLICATE
Translate BookNotFoundException into HTTP 404 with errorCode BOOK_NOT_FOUND
Return consistent ErrorResponse payloads

endpoints.summary: Register a new book with a unique ISBN, title and author
Update the title of an existing book identified by its ISBN
Retrieve a book by ISBN for catalog audit
Delete a book from the catalog by ISBN

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Audit Library API
  description: Auto-generated API contracts for audit-library conforming to Spring
    Boot 3 / Java 21 Records.
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
- url: http://localhost:8080
  description: Local server
paths:
  /api/v1/books:
    post:
      summary: Register a new book with a unique ISBN, title and author
      operationId: post_api_v1_books
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookResponse'
        '400':
          description: Error response 400
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
        '409':
          description: Error response 409
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateBookRequest'
  /api/v1/books/{isbn}:
    put:
      summary: Update the title of an existing book identified by its ISBN
      operationId: put_api_v1_books__isbn
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookResponse'
        '400':
          description: Error response 400
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
        '404':
          description: Error response 404
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UpdateBookRequest'
    get:
      summary: Retrieve a book by ISBN for catalog audit
      operationId: get_api_v1_books__isbn
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookResponse'
        '400':
          description: Error response 400
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
        '404':
          description: Error response 404
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
    delete:
      summary: Delete a book from the catalog by ISBN
      operationId: delete_api_v1_books__isbn
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Successful operation
        '400':
          description: Error response 400
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
        '404':
          description: Error response 404
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetails:
      type: object
      required:
      - timestamp
      - status
      - message
      properties:
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        status:
          type: integer
        message:
          type: string
        details:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
    BookResponse:
      type: object
      description: Immutable Java Record response for Book
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        isbn: &id001
          type: string
        title: &id002
          type: string
        author: &id003
          type: string
        createdAt: &id004
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updatedAt: &id005
          type: string
          format: date-time
    CreateBookRequest:
      type: object
      description: Immutable Java Record request with Jakarta validation for Book
      required:
      - isbn
      - title
      - author
      - createdAt
      - updatedAt
      properties:
        isbn: *id001
        title: *id002
        author: *id003
        createdAt: *id004
        updatedAt: *id005

userStories.intent: register a new book with a unique ISBN, title and author
userStories.benefit: the library catalog is kept accurate and no duplicate titles can be registered under the same ISBN

scenarios.given: the library catalog does not contain any book with ISBN '9783161484100'
scenarios.when: the Librarian sends POST /api/v1/books with body { "isbn": "9783161484100", "title": "Clean Code", "author": "Robert C. Martin" }
scenarios.then: the service persists the book with a generated UUID and createdAt timestamp and responds with HTTP 201 Created, a Location header '/api/v1/books/9783161484100' and the created representation including isbn, title and author

scenarios.given: a book with ISBN '9783161484100' already exists in the catalog
scenarios.when: the Librarian sends POST /api/v1/books with body { "isbn": "9783161484100", "title": "Another Title", "author": "Another Author" }
scenarios.then: the service does not create a second record and responds with HTTP 409 Conflict and errorCode 'BOOK_ISBN_DUPLICATE'

scenarios.given: the library catalog is available and the client is authenticated as Librarian
scenarios.when: the Librarian sends POST /api/v1/books with body { "isbn": "9783161484100", "title": "   ", "author": "Robert C. Martin" }
scenarios.then: the service rejects the request with HTTP 400 Bad Request and a field-level validation error indicating that 'title' must not be blank

scenarios.when: the Librarian sends POST /api/v1/books with body { "isbn": "ABC-123", "title": "Clean Code", "author": "Robert C. Martin" }
scenarios.then: the service responds with HTTP 400 Bad Request and a field-level validation error indicating that 'isbn' does not match the expected format

userStories.intent: update the title of an existing book identified by its ISBN
userStories.benefit: corrected or refined metadata is reflected in the catalog without changing the book identity

scenarios.given: a book with ISBN '9783161484100' and title 'Clean Code' exists in the catalog
scenarios.when: the Librarian sends PUT /api/v1/books/9783161484100 with body { "title": "Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship" }
scenarios.then: the service updates the stored title, sets updatedAt, leaves isbn and author unchanged and responds with HTTP 200 OK containing the updated representation

scenarios.given: no book with ISBN '9783161484100' exists in the catalog
scenarios.when: the Librarian sends PUT /api/v1/books/9783161484100 with body { "title": "Valid New Title" }
scenarios.then: the service responds with HTTP 404 Not Found and errorCode 'BOOK_NOT_FOUND', and no record is created

scenarios.given: a book with ISBN '9783161484100' exists in the catalog
scenarios.when: the Librarian sends PUT /api/v1/books/9783161484100 with body { "title": "" }
scenarios.then: the service rejects the request with HTTP 400 Bad Request, the stored title remains 'Clean Code' and no updatedAt change is persisted

userStories.intent: retrieve a book by its ISBN to verify catalog integrity
userStories.benefit: catalog data can be inspected and audited without modifying any record

scenarios.given: a book with ISBN '9783161484100', title 'Clean Code' and author 'Robert C. Martin' exists in the catalog
scenarios.then: the service responds with HTTP 200 OK and the full book representation including id, isbn, title, author and createdAt

scenarios.given: no book with ISBN '9780000000000' exists in the catalog
scenarios.then: the service responds with HTTP 404 Not Found and errorCode 'BOOK_NOT_FOUND'

scenarios.given: the catalog is available and read access is granted
scenarios.then: the service responds with HTTP 400 Bad Request and a validation error indicating that the ISBN format is invalid

userStories.intent: delete a book from the catalog by its ISBN
userStories.benefit: obsolete or incorrectly registered titles can be removed so the catalog stays reliable

scenarios.given: a book with ISBN '9783161484100' exists in the catalog
scenarios.then: the service removes the record and responds with HTTP 204 No Content, and a subsequent GET for that ISBN returns HTTP 404

scenarios.given: no book with ISBN '9783161484100' exists in the catalog
scenarios.then: the service responds with HTTP 404 Not Found and errorCode 'BOOK_NOT_FOUND' and the catalog remains unchanged
the service responds with HTTP 400 Bad Request and a validation error indicating that the ISBN format is invalid
